name: Hardcoded credential
message: Read credentials from process.env at the boundary, never from a literal.

name: Suppressed type error
message: Fix the type or narrow it with a documented assertion; a suppression hides the next error too.

name: Dynamic evaluation
message: Dynamic evaluation of a string is an injection surface. Use an explicit dispatch table.

name: Left-behind console call
message: Use the project logger so the output has a level and a destination.

name: Secret material committed by path
message: Environment files and key material belong in a secret manager, never in Git. Remove it from the index and rotate the credential.
